c74object.name: touch.status
c74object.digest: Local Preset Engine, Downward Scanner, Multi-Curve Array Glider, and 3-Way Composition Sequencer Strip
c74object.description: Interactive touch preset engine, multi-channel parameter morpher, and compositional sequencer strip for the Touch JSUI Suite in Cycling '74 Max 9 (v8ui / jsui). Automatically discovers and snapshots all child and peer UI controls down the local patcher hierarchy into disk-backed JSON dictionaries. Features a 3-way master composition selector ("Y" space emblem), per-slot 10px transition style strips (Glide vs. Snap), instant touch-muting with sustain hold plateaus, Gen-style 0.0–1.0 phase normalization with directional range reversing (low_slot > high_slot), Metric vs. Poly temporal scaling, seamless circular wrapping, and a floating 3-tab settings inspector with an inline auto-repeat stepper widget.

inlet.digest: Recall slot, morph, phase ramp, range, or configuration messages
inlet.description: Accepts integers (direct 1-based slot recall), floating-point numbers (absolute slot morphing or Gen-style 0.0–1.0 normalized phase input), layout messages (grid), directional range commands (range, low_slot, high_slot), composition modes (master_mode, mode), per-cell overrides (behavior, mute), patcher re-scans (scan), and attribute configuration messages.

outlet.digest: Active slot index or continuous morph position
outlet.description: Outputs the integer 1-based active slot number on discrete recalls, or the continuous floating-point morph position during dragging, scrubbing, or external automation.
Outputs a set message with the active slot's display label string, formatted for direct connection to UI comment boxes, text displays, or routing matrices.
Outputs state notifications such as stored <slot> <name>, recalled <slot> <name>, saved <filepath>, master_mode <mode>, and slot_mute <slot> <state>.

method.name: int
method.description: Triggers an immediate 1-based preset recall, pushing saved states to all monitored controls, updating the active slot highlight, and sending notifications out Outlets 0, 1, and 2.

method.name: float
method.digest: Continuous morph or normalized phase input
method.description: When normalize is 0 (Absolute Mode), interpolates across slots using raw slot floats (e.g. 1.0 to N.0). When normalize is 1 (Gen-Style Mode), maps a universal 0.0–1.0 input phase across the defined low_slot and high_slot range. Respects per-slot transition rules (Glide vs. Snap) and holds previous sounds frozen through muted cells.

method.name: master_mode / mode
method.description:
Sets or cycles the Master 3-Way Mode:
0 / normal: Standard recall and drag. 10px header strips hidden.
1 / all_drag: Composition mode default to smooth Glide (~).
2 / all_snap: Composition mode default to 50% hard jump (!).
Sending the message without arguments cycles through the 3 modes.

method.name: range / set_range
method.description: Simultaneously sets low_slot and high_slot. Setting a start slot higher than the end slot (e.g. range 10 1) causes normalized 0.0–1.0 sweeps to run in reverse.

method.name: normalize
method.description: Enables (1) or disables (0) universal 0.0–1.0 input scaling. When disabled, input expects direct slot numbers.

method.name: time_mode
method.description:
Selects temporal scaling when driven by 0.0–1.0 ramps:
0 / poly / phase: Phase-locked cycle time. 0.0 to 1.0 spans the selected slot count, creating cross-metric polyrhythms.
1 / metric / step: Step-locked rate. Each individual slot has a fixed duration regardless of total slot count.

method.name: wrap
method.description: Enables (1) or disables (0) circular wrapping. When enabled, transitioning past the last slot smoothly bridges back into the first slot.

method.name: mute / toggle_mute
method.description: Toggles mute on the specified 1-based slot index. Muted slots dim into ghosted cells and act as sustain buffers, holding the previous active sound frozen throughout their duration.

method.name: behavior / set_behavior
method.description: Sets the transition style of a specific 1-based slot index to Glide (0, ~) or Snap (1, !).

method.name: cycle_behavior
method.description: Inverts the transition style of the specified slot between Glide (~) and Snap (!).

method.name: grid / layout
method.description: Configures columns and rows either as two integers or as a slash-separated string (e.g. grid 8 1 or grid 4/2).

method.name: save_slot / store_slot
method.digest: Save current patch state to slot
method.description: Captures the live parameters of all discovered controls and writes the snapshot to the specified 1-based slot index in the module's JSON dictionary. If no argument is passed, saves to the currently active slot.

method.name: rename_slot
method.description: Assigns a new label to the specified 1-based slot index and writes it to disk.

method.name: rename_palette_slot / rename
method.description: Updates an entry in the preset naming bank for the double-tap palette.

method.name: scan
method.description: Traverses the local patcher and subpatchers to discover all active jsui and v8ui client controls.

method.name: clients / clientwindow
method.description: Opens or closes the floating tree/flat inspector showing all discovered client controls and their live values.

method.name: clear_names
method.description: Wipes auto-generated script names from controls across the local patcher.

method.name: popup
method.description: Opens or closes the 3-tab floating inspector window.

method.name: refresh / bang
method.description: Repaints the main interface strip and any open sub-windows.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description: Unique identifier string for this module. Determines the JSON dictionary storage filename (<name>.json) and bus registration name.

attribute.name: grid
attribute.description: Slot topology specified as cols/rows (e.g. 4/1, 8/1, 4/4).

attribute.name: master_mode
attribute.description:
Sets the Master 3-Way Mode displayed on the custom "Y" button:
0: Normal (Normal touch recall and drag, 10px headers hidden).
1: All Drag (Composition mode, all cells default to Glide ~).
2: All Snap (Composition mode, all cells default to Snap !).

attribute.name: slot_behaviors
attribute.description: Space-separated list of transition styles for each slot in composition mode.

attribute.name: normalize
attribute.description: Toggles between Gen-style universal 0.0–1.0 normalized phase input (1) and raw slot float input (0).

attribute.name: low_slot
attribute.description: 1-based starting slot index for the 0.0–1.0 normalized sweep. Setting this higher than high_slot causes sequence traversal to run in reverse. Controlled via the inline stepper widget (◀ Val ▶) in the inspector.

attribute.name: high_slot
attribute.description: 1-based ending slot index for the 0.0–1.0 normalized sweep. Controlled via the inline stepper widget (◀ Val ▶) in the inspector.

attribute.name: time_mode
attribute.description:
Determines temporal scaling when driven by normalized ramps:
0: Poly (Phase): Total cycle duration is phase-locked. Different slot counts produce authentic polyrhythmic ratios (e.g. 4 against 5).
1: Metric (Step): Step duration is fixed. Slots progress at a constant step-rate regardless of sequence length.

attribute.name: wrap
attribute.description: When enabled (1), continuous counter sweeps past the ending slot wrap around into the starting slot without a hard jump.

attribute.name: slot_names
attribute.description: Comma-separated string of custom names assigned to grid slots.

attribute.name: popup_slots
attribute.description: Comma-separated bank of preset names available in the quick double-tap palette.

attribute.name: allow_hold_save
attribute.description: Enables (1) or disables (0) touch-and-hold saving on slot cells in Normal mode (automatically locked out during composition modes).

attribute.name: hold_threshold
attribute.description: Duration in milliseconds required to hold a slot before saving the current state (default 500 ms).

attribute.name: double_tap_threshold
attribute.description: Maximum interval in milliseconds between taps to open the quick naming palette (default 320 ms).

attribute.name: text_size
attribute.description: Base typography point size for slot numbers and preset labels inside cells.

attribute.name: font_style
attribute.description: Typography weight/slant: Regular (0), Bold (1), Italic (2), or Bold Italic (3).

attribute.name: borders
attribute.description: Toggles display of the outer corner reticle bracket lines.

attribute.name: border_radius
attribute.description: Corner curvature radius in pixels of outer brackets and interior buttons.

attribute.name: border_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke width in pixels of outer corner reticle brackets.

attribute.name: border_extension
attribute.description: Length in pixels of corner bracket arms extending along the object edge.

attribute.name: bg_color
attribute.description: RGBA fill color of inactive cell bodies.

attribute.name: border_color
attribute.description: RGBA stroke color of outer reticle brackets and inactive borders.

attribute.name: highlight_color
attribute.description: RGBA accent color used for the active cell body and morph transition crossfades.

attribute.name: text_color
attribute.description: RGBA color for slot numbers and preset name typography.

attribute.name: accent_bar_color
attribute.description: RGBA fill color for the scanner launcher button and the last-stored indicator underline.

attribute.name: popup_dot_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the red inspector launcher dot in the upper-right corner.

attribute.name: pop_bgcolor
attribute.description: Base background fill color for all floating sub-windows (Inspector, Scanned Clients, Ticker, Palette, Color Picker).

attribute.name: attr_bg_color
attribute.description: Background fill color for individual parameter rows and sub-window items.

attribute.name: attr_border_color
attribute.description: Stroke color for attribute parameter outlines and row dividers.

attribute.name: attr_slider_color
attribute.description: Fill color for active slider gauges inside inspector parameter rows.

attribute.name: attr_text_color
attribute.description: Typography color for parameter titles, numerical readouts, and sub-window labels.

attribute.name: allow_popup
attribute.description: Enables (1) or disables (0) the red launcher dot in the upper-right corner.

attribute.name: active_mask_tab
attribute.description: Active tab in the 3-tab settings inspector: Performance (0), Geometry / Labels (1), or Colors (2).
